summary.en: A vector field assigns a vector to every point in space; the gradient of a scalar field is the vector field pointing in the direction of steepest increase, and it is always perpendicular to the field's level surfaces.
summary.et: Vektorväli seab igale ruumipunktile vastavusse vektori; skalaarvälja gradient on vektorväli, mis osutab kõige järsema kasvu suunas, ja see on alati risti välja nivoopindadega.
